surface_mechanism_description: During the preparation of ODS SAMs, water-vapor pulses alternated with ODS exposure. When a surface with SAM precursor molecules was exposed to water vapor, the unreacted alkoxy groups of chemisorbed molecules were hydroxylated. During the following exposure to SAM precursor, the precursor molecules could bond to these groups and unreacted surface OH-groups.
